answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using cryptographic proof-of-burn. Whether an agent automates an apple orchard or monitors a flying ember during a gale, it must register by destroying scarce native tokens in an unspendable address. Attackers face an inescapable, linear capital cost for each spoofed identity. However, this creates a wealth barrier for legitimate, low-budget agents and cannot stop well-funded adversaries.
